competences.description: Smites the enemy, removing 1 beneficial effect and decreasing Attack Speed and Attack Power for 3 turns.
Strikes all enemies, decreasing their Defense for 3 turns.

Whenever attacked, deals damage to the attacker with burning flames and recovers the Boss's HP in proportion to the damage dealt. In addition, increases the Attack Power by 20%, up to 200%, when the Boss gets attacked by the enemy with a Glancing Hit. Resets when the next turn ends. [Automatic Effect]
